doc.title: Benny Waters interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995

title: Forty years in Europe and making more money
summary: He lived in Europe forty years, earned more there, and did solo work.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You are one of the musicians that decided to live in Europe for a while.
Tell us about some of your experiences there.
Well I had quite a lot. You know what I mean?
Well I mean compare it to the United States.

Well I had a very good deal in Europe. I, the first thing, I made money, and I guess that’s what every musician wants to do you know? So I made more money in Europe than I did in America. Well everybody did but the times were different, see? I guess when I was working at Small’s I guess the money was about, well everything was cheaper, I guess it was maybe about the same thing. But I started doing solo work. And solo work is where you make money, see? It’s hard work because you play with everybody — good musicians, bad musicians, all types. But you can make more money, see?
